entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The rain was relentless.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The first, heavy drops of rain had started to fall Drops the size of bullets hammered at the windows.
entries.zh: 第一次,大雨开始倒下 子弹的大小在窗户上敲击。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Layers of pregnant clouds clung to the mountain and blanketed the forest.
entries.zh: 层层的怀孕云笼罩在山上 覆盖森林

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The rain was hammering down and a chilly stream poured down his face.
entries.zh: 雨倒在地,一股寒冷的溪流倒在他脸上.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The trees flinched and the grass shivered in the freezing rain.
entries.zh: 树上松缩,草间在冻雨中颤抖.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Melting chips of ice hammered on his head and face, and streamed down the back of his neck.
entries.zh: 融化的冰片敲打他的头和脸,并流下他的脖子后部.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The dancing hail hung in a cloud and drove along the road like smoke.
entries.zh: 舞冰雹挂在云中,像烟雾一样沿路行驶.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The rain was a steady downpour of tears, crashing to earth and spreading darkness and damp.
entries.zh: 雨是流着泪水的平稳倒流 坠落到地上 散发着黑暗和潮湿

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The puddles jumped to life as pellets of water drummed the surface.
entries.zh: 水坑在水面上打鼓时跳过生命

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The downpour had flooded the gutters. Even after the rain had stopped, water dripped like the tick of a very slow clock.
entries.zh: 下水淹没了水沟,即使雨停了,水滴也像一个很慢的钟滴一样。

entries.en: Hung over the park

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Descended from the mountain

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Blanketed everything like a padded quilt
entries.zh: 把一切都打得像被子一样

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Crept up on the house

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Slid along the window

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Crept along the forest floor

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Flicked its tongue into every gap
entries.zh: 把舌头往每个缝隙里飞

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Prowled and slithered over their feet

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Covered his feet and muffled all sound
entries.zh: 盖住他的脚, 搅动所有的声音

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Drifted up from the soggy soil

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Filled the air with its slinky, grey arms
entries.zh: 满空中充满了它那柔软的灰色手臂

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Twisted the trees into monstrous shapes
entries.zh: 把树扭曲成可怕的形状

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Waited a moment and then slipped back along the path
entries.zh: 等了一会儿,然后沿路滑了回去

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Hung like a stilled breath on everything that it touched
entries.zh: 雄如静息的呼吸,在它触摸的一切

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: There was a blanket of grey mist floating above the grass.
entries.zh: 有一毯灰雾飘在草地上

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The mist rose and spread to fill the air with its slinky, grey arms.
entries.zh: 烟雾升起并蔓延到空气中充满了它的细腻,灰色的手臂.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The mist was like an icy breath descending from the mountain.
entries.zh: 雾如冰冷的气息从山上流下

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The fog blanketed everything like a padded quilt.
entries.zh: 浓雾笼罩了一切 像一个插毯。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wind moaned and howled like a ghostly spirit and dragged with it a veil of stinging mist from the river.
entries.zh: 风声呻吟,呼呼如鬼魂,并随其拖着河边刺雾的面纱.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A brooding mist crept low along the ground, prowling around them, slithering over their feet.
entries.zh: 一片浓密的雾水沿地面低沉,绕着它们,在它们的脚上滑动.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Coils of mist drifted up from the soggy soil and hung like a stilled breath on everything they touched.
entries.zh: 烟雾的焦土从肥沃的土壤中漂移起来, 像静静的呼吸一样挂在他们碰过的一切上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A damp, yellow fog hung over the park and twisted the trees into monstrous shapes.
entries.zh: 一片潮湿的黄色雾笼罩着公园 把树木扭曲成可怕的形状

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The fog crept up on the house like a ghostly serpent, slid along the window, flicked its tongue into the corners of the house, waited a moment and then slipped back along the path.
entries.zh: 雾像鬼蛇一样凝聚在房子上,沿着窗户滑动,把舌头闪到房子的角落里,等待片刻,然后沿路滑回去.
